name: node-file-primitive
body: The edge-preserving durable write primitive in src/layers.rs: `write_project` / `validate_change` / `write_through_with_deletes`. It is the shared plumbing an `update` uses — read the existing NodeFile, mutate only allowed fields, keep out/in edges, validate the complete change, write atomically, commit once, re-merge the DB. The refuse-on-existing check for `add` belongs beside `validate_change` (which today exempts an overwritten FQN from its uniqueness universe).
